finding.finding: The snapshots establish loss of grid power at Beruwala and Padukka, and a down HOM12-to-PAD85 transmission path. No equipment-state claim is made.

Resolved faults are S01 and S09 grid power failures and L09 backhaul failure. S08 grid-power status remains unknown; do not assume either state. Available crews have equipment and generator skills, but no backhaul skill is listed. Roads are all reported open. G1 is available at DEPOT; its 120-minute capacity and 10-minute deployment duration are recorded, but its fuel/runtime adequacy for any intended use is not established. No action is deferred: the evidence identifies no unsafe or impossible condition.

questions.question: Can you confirm whether S08 currently has grid power?
Can a backhaul-skilled crew be made available for L09 repair? Neither listed crew has backhaul skill.
For any planned generator deployment, is G1’s 120-minute capacity sufficient for the required temporary-power period?

finding.finding: Policy-approved priorities remain unchanged: V09 (S09, Padukka) is critical with weight 5; all other services have weight 1. Current authoritative reports identify outages affecting S01 (Beruwala) and S09 (Padukka), and a down transmission path from S08 (Homagama) to S09. S09 outage matters most under the approved weights. S01 is also down but has standard weight. S08 power is unknown, and the Gampaha notice is for a future interruption, so neither establishes a current outage. Customer complaints and the unconfirmed Padukka repair rumor do not establish operational state.

findings: The cited authoritative snapshots support the recorded grid_power_ok=false facts for Beruwala (S01), Homagama (S08), and Padukka (S09), and backhaul_ok=false for link L09. They do not establish equipment status.
The Veyangoda complaint, planned Gampaha interruption, and unconfirmed Padukka repair rumour are correctly excluded as operational facts.

The generator deployment targets Beruwala (S01), whose grid outage is verified. Its route and timing are consistent: travel precedes work, and 5 + 10 = 15 minutes for work end. The unresolved Homagama power state is explicitly handled as an unknown.
